scoring.independence: Both criteria are published upstream by NVIDIA, independently of this intake; both encode the same correctness predicate and are not independent statistical validations.
scoring.reserve_definition: Add Confidence / abs(MC-BS) only where error >1e-6, divide by full option count. Confidence is discounted 1.96-standard-error width.
scoring.printed_boundary: Six-decimal reserve output can round to 1.000000; use verdict or unrounded statistic at boundary.
